purpose: staged CPU pilot; no universal superiority claim
training_budget_note: paired pilot models have identical budgets; saved V2 used 300 physics updates on three grids, so its scores are contextual comparisons only
validation_rule: use all nonconstant validation trajectories at each declared grid, component-normalized solution MSE and paired L1; never use test or final holdout for selection
phase4_gate: defer head expansion if matched-input pilot does not establish a repeatable numerical gain or conservative safeguard remains costly
holdout_rule: specifications generated and hashed before model training; use once after freezing candidates; no hyperparameter changes afterwards
limitations: pilot grid range and optimization budget
Shu-Osher short-time run is stability-only until a converged matched-time reference exists
